EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7 My Ref No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/37.

Land Ref. No.: 4/3/10/2016/LRB/304. I, hereby give notice under Sub - section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government has acquired the allotment of lands required for the widening and development of the existing canal to drain the rainwater collected in the upper part of Gangarama Road into Maha Ela under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage and Environment Improvement Project.
Description of the land to be acquired:

Allotments of land, depcted as lot numbers: 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 11, 13, 14, 17, 18, 19, 22, 23 and 24 in Sheet No. 19, Block No. 07 in the Cadastral Map No. 521203 dated 18.12.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Thumbowila in the Grama Niladhari Division No, 576B of Thumbowila in
the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kesbewa in Colombo district and bounded as follows:
